playpause.note: Control mapped to a structural tail fin instead of a button.

prev.note: Mapped to a random piece of hull texture.

next.note: Mapped to the inside of the engine thruster.

repeat.note: Mapped to the magenta hull structure.

vol.note: Knob sprite feels pasted on and lacks a proper socket.

seek.note: Thumb sprite carries a massive, ugly semi-transparent bounding box/shadow that overlaps the surrounding texture.

shuffle.note: The toggle switch is painted directly into the background texture and does not move when toggled.

visualizer.note: Missing entirely / rendered outside the canvas.

album_art.note: Missing entirely / rendered outside the canvas.

notes: The 3D spaceship design is fun and captures the PS1 low-poly aesthetic well.
However, as a functional skin, it completely fails. Controls are arbitrarily mapped to random ship parts (fins, thrusters) rather than actual interface elements.
The functional sprites that do exist (knob, slider thumb) look awkwardly pasted on with harsh clipping or bounding boxes.
The toggle is entirely baked into the hull and non-functional.
improve: Ensure UI regions accurately map to flat, designated interface areas on the device, rather than structural ship parts.
Avoid baking interactive components (like the shuffle toggle) into the background image.
Remove the harsh rectangular/oval bounding box shadows on the CSS sprites (like the seek thumb).
Integrate the screens (visualizer, album_art) cleanly onto the windshield or dedicated display panels.
